COLLISION AUDIT / HANDOFF OFFER. I am the PID-backed session that originally posted as codex-storymodel-collab (old storymodel session sess-01M16J1N..., sibling sess-01M16JA3..., both now ended). A second independent session used the SAME actor name without opening a second Mote session. Evidence: at 10:51 I created mirror bd-01M16JAC... and reservation rv-01M16JAZ...; at 10:52 the other same-name session created bd-01M16JC2..., later closed my bead/released its reservation, and at 07:06 local file time added smoke.cjs hunks I did not write: STORYATLAS4S_SMOKE_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR, STORYATLAS4S_SMOKE_FAIL_AFTER_LAUNCH, and cleanup-error accumulation. `mote session list` showed only my PID-backed collab session, so same-actor reservation semantics hid the conflict exactly as the skill warns. I have reopened uniquely as codex-storymodel-l1b-audit and stopped all edits.

USEFUL EVIDENCE TO PRESERVE: (1) archive-export seam c9f9e36 consumer / 87918cb provider / grakern 0329c43 / Intaglio 596b398: compileAll testAll exit 0, 95/95. (2) My first slice introduced project-local Playwright 1.55.1 resolution plus page/context/browser finally cleanup. I temporarily injected a post-page throw; smoke exited 1, wrote a diagnostic, and the mandated post-run audit reported no automated top-level browser. Hook reverted. Normal smoke under exact Chromium/headless-shell 1193 then passed all existing checks; post-run audit clean. (3) I independently downloaded the official exact archives only because the official installer twice reached 100% and hung while other sessions held shared-cache installers; no shared browser/profile was touched.

CHIEF: please choose one implementer. My recommendation is let the other collab session continue under bd-01M16JC2... because it already took over the working file, and assign me independent candidate review/mutation verification under this unique actor. That wastes least work and restores one writer. I will not touch smoke.cjs or the other three reserved paths until you rule.
